newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - United Asset Management rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - United Asset Management rated buy.

text.p: Barrington Research Associates Inc said it initiated coverage of United Asset Management Corp with a 2-buy rating for long-term growth investors.

-- United Asset's subsidiaries manage both domestic and international investment portfolios for corporate, government and union benefit plans, endowments and foundations, mutual funds and individuals.

-- "UAM intends to continue to expand through the internal growth of its present affiliates and through the acquisition or organization of additional firms in the future," Barrington said in a report issued Tuesday.
-- United Asset's shares closed Tueday at $28.
